# Desktop fixtures

`queue-snapshot.json` and `runtime-contract.json` are shared frontend/native contract samples. `text.docx` is the generated Chinese/body-text sample used by the plain-text conversion checks.

`embedded-font.pdf` is a generated, single-page 240 × 100 pt document with the text `Z8.Work PDF 2026` and the project's Host Grotesk Regular font embedded as a TrueType program. It does not depend on an installed OS font. This is a Latin glyph sample, not a CJK fallback-font test.

- Generator: [desktop-pdf-font-fixture.py](../../../scripts/desktop-pdf-font-fixture.py), Python 3, fontTools 4.62.1 and Brotli. Run from the repository root with a **new** output filename, then compare bytes with the checked-in fixture.
- Font input: [HostGrotesk-Regular.woff2](../../../src/lib/assets/font/HostGrotesk-Regular.woff2), SHA-256 `229464c7a47ce1bf7382667f98b5e52037ff0095b1dbaa7283fed7b66b6a6c15`.
- PDF SHA-256: `02581e9af3cdb756b8b8ccf4a3f6baeee27831316254e64577ba549114c65bed`.
- Copyright 2023 The Host Grotesk Project Authors ([upstream](https://github.com/Element-Type/HostGrotesk)). The font's embedded name table identifies SIL Open Font License 1.1. The accompanying [OFL text](HostGrotesk-OFL.txt) was retrieved from [Google Fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/hostgrotesk/OFL.txt) on 2026-09-09, SHA-256 `f04ad0873907546e160c7a79b1e42bd3cd380c7e5ee4c1b3c11f43faca1675e7`.

Other Phase 27 samples are generated by the native harness: transparent PNG, a 16-bit gradient, EXIF orientation 6, Display P3 ICC, three-page base-14-font PDF, and stereo 440/880 Hz audio in explicitly chosen containers/codecs. The HEIC seed and ICC profile are described in [the shared fixture notes](../../../tests/fixtures/README.md). The small photograph is ImageMagick's built-in `rose:` ([official format documentation](https://imagemagick.org/formats/)); it is 70 × 46 pixels and is not representative of high-resolution photos. Reports retain each generated input's SHA-256; image generation can differ across engine versions.
